title: pm: a same-head PASS record that still lists an open should-fix clears the queue guard
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (follow-up G of a Fable evaluation of the low-risk Tier H delegation that Leehom asked for, write-up `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/review/33531-delegation-review.md`, read on PR #33531 head `e2b1cabc`; rated not blocking the merge of #33531). `reach:` a head whose record is PASS with a should-fix still owed can be landed by the seat, because the guard reads only the word PASS.

**What is wrong.** The contract-review rule says a should-fix earns a delta review of its fix before landing. The queue guard (and the low-risk arm in PR #33531) reads `VERDICT: PASS` on a same-head record and nothing else, so a PASS record that lists an open should-fix on that very head clears the guard.

**What lands.** Either the guard reads the record's finding grades and refuses a same-head PASS that lists an open must-fix or should-fix, or the seat's pre-landing check does, and the rule text says which. Pin it.

`scripts/pm/**`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`; `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`. Related: #33541 (the Tier S leg reads no verdict at all). Dedupe: `is:issue PASS should-fix owed guard` → none. **New.**
